title: Ordered simplex caps and the three-observation Stringer bound: source and supporting computations
description: Source and supporting computations for the nine-page preprint Ordered simplex caps and the three-observation Stringer bound. An exact rational tetrahedral cap calculation and a stationary-face argument prove the sharp pointwise Stringer-Gaffke comparison for three independent, identically distributed observations. A terminal-edge derivative gives an all-dimensional obstruction. The proposed five- and six-coordinate global cap extensions and their dependent confidence continua remain conjectural: the existing first-coordinate beta inequalities do not establish the required active-prefix inequality on repeated-lowest-knot faces. The archive preserves the local computations, independent fixed-level results, other research notes, and the mathematically separate systematic-PPS manuscript with their stated scopes.
